# Glossary

Derived from every `definition` in the knowledge base.

| term | aliases | id | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Invoice | — | `ko.definition.billing.invoice` | The charge raised for a signed contract Sales published. |
| Invoice already issued | — | `ko.definition.billing.invoice-already-issued` | The domain error raised when issue is attempted on an invoice already issued. |
| Invoice not issued | — | `ko.definition.billing.invoice-not-issued` | The domain error raised when payment is attempted on a draft invoice. |
| Invoice terminal | — | `ko.definition.billing.invoice-terminal` | The domain error raised when any trigger reaches a paid invoice. |
| Customer | `client` | `ko.definition.sales.customer` | The party a proposal is issued to. |
| Customer proposals | — | `ko.definition.sales.customer-proposals` | The proposals currently open for one customer, read across two aggregates. |
| Proposal | — | `ko.definition.sales.proposal` | A priced offer issued to a customer, valid for a bounded period. |
| Proposal already issued | — | `ko.definition.sales.proposal-already-issued` | The domain error raised when issue is attempted on a proposal already issued. |
| Proposal expired | — | `ko.definition.sales.proposal-expired` | The domain error raised when acceptance is attempted after the validity window closed. |
| Proposal item | — | `ko.definition.sales.proposal-item` | One priced line inside a proposal, with no identity outside the proposal. |
| Proposal not issued | — | `ko.definition.sales.proposal-not-issued` | The domain error raised when a draft proposal receives a trigger that requires issue. |
| Proposal terminal | — | `ko.definition.sales.proposal-terminal` | The domain error raised when any trigger reaches a proposal in a terminal state. |
